mapper.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT objectid, shape FROM ${t.district} WHERE shape IS NOT NULL)
CASE WHEN lower(trim(${c})) IN ('', 'n/a', 'na', 'undefined', 'null', '-') THEN NULL ELSE trim(${c}) END
mapper.select: SELECT objectid AS district_key, districtid AS makani_id, municipalityname AS municipality, nameenglish AS makani_name, namearabic AS name_ar, round((ST_Area(ST_Transform(shape, 32640)) / 1e6)::numeric, 3) AS area_km2, ST_X(ST_PointOnSurface(shape)) AS centroid_lon, ST_Y(ST_PointOnSurface(shape)) AS centroid_lat, ST_XMin(shape) AS min_lon, ST_YMin(shape) AS min_lat, ST_XMax(shape) AS max_lon, ST_YMax(shape) AS max_lat, encode(ST_AsEWKB(ST_Multi(ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology(ST_Force2D(shape), #{tol}))), 'hex') AS boundary_hex, encode(ST_AsEWKB(ST_Multi(ST_Force2D(shape))), 'hex') AS scope_hex FROM ${t.district} WHERE shape IS NOT NULL
SELECT d.objectid AS district_key, count(*) AS n FROM d JOIN ${t.community} x ON GROUP BY d.objectid

SELECT d.objectid AS district_key, count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.construction_status = 'Constructed') AS constructed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.construction_status = 'Under Construction') AS under_construction, count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.construction_status = 'Not Constructed' AND x.servicestatus = 'available') AS vacant_serviced, count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.construction_status = 'Not Constructed' AND x.servicestatus IN ('notAvailable', 'notAvailableHaveConsNOC')) AS vacant_unserviced FROM d JOIN ${t.plot} x ON GROUP BY d.objectid
SELECT d.objectid AS district_key, coalesce(nullif(trim(x.primaryuseengdesc), ''), 'Undefined') AS use_desc, count(*) AS plot_count FROM d JOIN ${t.plot} x ON GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT d.objectid AS district_key, count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.physicalstatus IN ('underConstruction', 'Under Construction')) AS under_construction FROM d JOIN ${t.building} x ON GROUP BY d.objectid
SELECT d.objectid AS district_key, count(*) AS n FROM d JOIN ${t.school} x ON GROUP BY d.objectid

SELECT d.objectid AS district_key, count(*) AS n FROM d JOIN ${t.doh} x ON WHERE x.facility_category = 'Medical'
AND NOT (coalesce(x.facility_name_in_english, '') ILIKE ANY (ARRAY[ #{p} ]::text[]))
GROUP BY d.objectid
SELECT d.objectid AS district_key, count(*) AS n FROM d JOIN ${t.mosque} x ON GROUP BY d.objectid

SELECT d.objectid AS district_key, x.buildingid AS building_id, round(coalesce(nullif(x.buildingheight, 0), x.buildingnumberoffloors * 3.5, 6)::numeric, 1) AS height, (x.physicalstatus IN ('underConstruction', 'Under Construction')) AS under_construction, jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object( 'name', , 'nameAr', , 'popularName', , 'floors', nullif(x.buildingnumberoffloors, 0), 'physicalStatus', , 'usageType', , 'primaryUse', , 'secondaryUsage', , 'community', , 'completionDate', x.completiondate::date ))::text AS attrs, encode(ST_AsEWKB(ST_Force2D(x.shape)), 'hex') AS geom_hex FROM d JOIN ${t.building} x ON WHERE x.shape IS NOT NULL

SELECT d.objectid AS district_key, x.plotid AS plot_id, CASE WHEN x.construction_status = 'Constructed' THEN 'constructed' WHEN x.construction_status = 'Under Construction' THEN 'under_construction' WHEN x.construction_status = 'Not Constructed' AND x.servicestatus = 'available' THEN 'vacant_serviced' WHEN x.construction_status = 'Not Constructed' AND x.servicestatus IN ('notAvailable', 'notAvailableHaveConsNOC') THEN 'vacant_unserviced' ELSE 'other' END AS status, coalesce(nullif(trim(x.primaryuseengdesc), ''), 'Undefined') AS use_desc, jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object( 'plotNo', , 'community', , 'areaM2', round(nullif(x.plotcalculatedarea, 0)), 'constructionStatus', , 'serviceStatus', , 'landUse', , 'secondaryUse', , 'planningStatus', , 'allocationStatus', , 'allocation', , 'ownership', , 'devCode', , 'far', , 'maxGfaM2', round(nullif(x.devcode_maxgfa, 0)), 'maxHeight', nullif(, '0'), 'investmentZone', , 'permitType', , 'permitDate', x.permit_lastdate::date ))::text AS attrs, encode(ST_AsEWKB(ST_Force2D(x.shape)), 'hex') AS geom_hex FROM d JOIN ${t.plot} x ON WHERE x.shape IS NOT NULL

SELECT d.objectid AS district_key, 'school' AS category, x.objectid::text AS source_id, x.adek_sch_name_en AS name_en, x.adek_sch_name_ar AS name_ar, x.adek_sch_education_type_en AS subtype, ST_X(ST_Centroid(x.shape)) AS lon, ST_Y(ST_Centroid(x.shape)) AS lat, jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object( 'curriculum', , 'gender', , 'grades', , 'cycle', , 'students', x.adek_n_students, 'capacity', nullif(x.adek_sch_capacity, 0), 'teachingStaff', x.adek_n_teaching_staff, 'totalStaff', x.adek_n_total_staff, 'rating', , 'feeCategory', , 'avgFeeAed', nullif(x.adek_sch_average_tuition_fee, 0), 'academicYear', , 'community', , 'esisId', ))::text AS attrs FROM d JOIN ${t.school} x ON UNION ALL SELECT d.objectid, 'medical', x.objectid::text, x.facility_name_in_english, x.facility_name_in_arabic, x.facility_type, ST_X(ST_Centroid(x.shape)), ST_Y(ST_Centroid(x.shape)), jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object( 'subType', , 'specialities', , 'isPublic', , 'beds', nullif(, '0'), 'emergency', , 'address', , 'licenseNo', , 'licenseStatus', , 'licenseExpiry', x.date_expiration::date ))::text FROM d JOIN ${t.doh} x ON WHERE x.facility_category = 'Medical'
AND NOT (coalesce(x.facility_name_in_english, '') ILIKE ANY (ARRAY[ #{p} ]::text[]))
UNION ALL SELECT d.objectid, 'mosque', x.objectid::text, NULL, coalesce(nullif(trim(x."اسم_المسجد"), ''), 'مسجد ' || coalesce(x."رقم_المسجد", x.objectid::text)), x."صفة_المسجد_1", ST_X(ST_Centroid(x.shape)), ST_Y(ST_Centroid(x.shape)), '{}' FROM d JOIN ${t.mosque} x ON
